name: AK27 - Indoor VOC & Particle Counter (TVOC, HCHO, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, Temperature, Humidity, AQI), Formaldehyde Detector for Renovation
highlights: 10-in-1 Professional Indoor Air Quality Monitor:Monitor essential indoor air indicators including PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, HCHO, TVOC, Temperature, Humidity, AQI and Time. Get a complete view of your indoor environment in real time.
Advanced Multi-Sensor Detection:Track airborne particles and pollutants with high-sensitivity sensors. Detect PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, HCHO and TVOC to better understand your indoor air quality.
Large Color Display, Easy to Read:The oversized full-color screen clearly displays air quality data, AQI levels, temperature and humidity. View important information instantly from across the room.
Smart AQI Indicator & Real-Time Alerts:Color-coded AQI indicators make air quality changes easy to understand. Quickly know when ventilation or environmental adjustments may be needed.
Designed for Everyday Indoor Use:Perfect for bedrooms, living rooms, offices, nurseries and more. Monitor your home's environment anytime with a sleek desktop design.
